{{Quote
|Hr = Journal
|Brutish cook responsible for dicing Muckroach meat into edible portions.<hr/>
Could their actions be called skill? I see only a crude mangling of meat. Yet I wonder, before the Haunting snared their minds was it any different?
}}

<b>Roachservers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are brutish [[Roach Tenders]] of the [[Sinner's Road]] responsible for dicing up [[Muckroach]]es.<ref>Roachserver Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Brutish cook responsible for dicing Muckroach meat into edible portions."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Roachservers are flying enemies, and try to maintain distance between themselves and Hornet before closing in for an attack.<br>
Once Hornet is in range, Roachservers chop diagonally downwards with their knife twice, moving diagonally downwards more with each slice, then flying backwards.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Is this enough? Is it ever enough?
* A holy gift...
* For the work to sustain...
* Carve it! Sear it! Stew it!
}}

== Location ==
Two Roachservers appear in [[Disgraced Chef Lugoli]]'s arena in [[Sinner's Road]], and must be defeated before the boss arrives.
